criteria.name: DA003
criteria.description:
三县366日索引与缺测准确，不用0或年度数字补造逐日观测。
Inspect output/outdoor_activity_model.xlsx, output/activity_policy_brief.docx, output/review_calendar.csv.
criteria.reasoning: Criterion DA003 requires: (1) three-county 366-day index with accurate missing observations, (2) no fabrication of daily observations using 0s or annual numbers. Verified against input data: Maricopa has 366 observed days (0 missing), Pima has 366 observed days (0 missing), Yuma has 365 observed days with 1 missing day (2024-11-26). The review_calendar.csv has 1098 rows (366 per county), with all 1097 observed rows matching source AQI values exactly and 0 mismatches. Yuma's single missing day is marked ObservationStatus='Missing' with blank AQI/SitesReporting/Category, not fabricated as 0. The outdoor_activity_model.xlsx AnnualReconciliation sheet correctly reconciles daily vs annual counts, and the DataAudit sheets accurately report the day counts and the Yuma missing date. The activity_policy_brief.docx (sections 2 and 4) explicitly states Yuma has 1 missing day (2024-11-26) and confirms 'we do not impute AQI=0 or interpolate.' No AQI=0 values exist in source daily data or in the calendar's missing rows. All three files are faithful to the inputs and correctly handle the missing observation without fabrication.

criteria.name: DA004
criteria.description:
六档天数、Days with AQI及Max AQI逐县重算准确，与原始年表逐项对账并如实处理差异。
Inspect output/outdoor_activity_model.xlsx, output/activity_policy_brief.docx, output/review_calendar.csv.
criteria.reasoning: Criterion DA004 is fully satisfied. The AnnualReconciliation sheet in outdoor_activity_model.xlsx correctly reconciles six AQI category days, Days with AQI, and Max AQI for all three counties against the original annual table. I verified by recalculating from daily_aqi_by_county_2024.csv: Maricopa (366 Days with AQI: 33 Good + 260 Moderate + 65 USG + 7 Unhealthy + 1 Very Unhealthy + 0 Hazardous, Max AQI=261), Pima (366 Days with AQI: 113 Good + 241 Moderate + 10 USG + 2 Unhealthy, Max AQI=171), and Yuma (365 Days with AQI: 212 Good + 149 Moderate + 3 USG + 1 Unhealthy, Max AQI=179) all match the annual table exactly. The missing Yuma day (2024-11-26) is honestly documented in both the DataAudit sheet and the reconciliation (MissingCount=1, Reconciliation='Exact match'). The review_calendar.csv also preserves the six-category labels per row, with the one missing day showing NaN category, consistent with the no-imputation policy. Differences are not fudged to force alignment — the single Yuma missing date is surfaced rather than filled with AQI=0, as required.

criteria.name: DA005

Inspect output/outdoor_activity_model.xlsx, output/activity_policy_brief.docx, output/review_calendar.csv.
criteria.reasoning: The review_calendar.csv contains 1,098 rows (366 days × 3 counties), including 312 weekend rows (Saturday/Sunday). The criterion requires the calendar to '仅含三县2024周一至周五' (only contain Mon-Fri weekdays), but the file includes all calendar days. While it does satisfy other aspects—all 262 weekdays per county are present (no omissions), all 11 federal holidays are included, and county-date pairs are unique with zero duplicates—the presence of 312 weekend rows violates the 'only weekdays' constraint. The xlsx ResourcePlan sheet contains only weekdays but is a subset of selected discretionary dates (67 rows), not a complete calendar.

criteria.name: DA006

A>=101、B>=151的超标室内标记与101至150的B动作准确。

criteria.reasoning: DA006 criterion fully satisfied. Verification of review_calendar.csv shows: (1) Policy A indoor markings for AQI>=101 are accurate - all 89 days with AQI>=101 correctly flagged with A_Indoor_Flag=1 and A_Action='Indoor (AQI>=101)'; all 1008 days with AQI<101 correctly flagged as 0 with 'Outdoor' action. (2) Policy B full indoor markings for AQI>=151 are accurate - all 11 days with AQI>=151 correctly flagged with B_FullIndoor_Flag=1 and B_Action='Indoor (AQI>=151)'. All flag columns and action text descriptions in review_calendar.csv are 100% accurate per the specified thresholds.

criteria.name: DA007
criteria.description:
缺测一律待测室内备用，单独标记且不混入观测超标或两政策差异。
Inspect output/outdoor_activity_model.xlsx, output/activity_policy_brief.docx, output/review_calendar.csv.
criteria.reasoning: The single missing day (Yuma 2024-11-26) is uniformly handled across all three deliverables: in review_calendar.csv it is marked ObservationStatus='Missing' with A_Action/B_Action='Pending test, indoor backup' and MissingBackup_Flag=1, while all observed-exceedance flags (A_Indoor_Flag, B_FullIndoor_Flag, B_ReducedOutdoor_Flag) and policy-difference fields (A_MoreIndoorThanB_Flag, DiffPersonHours) are 0; in outdoor_activity_model.xlsx the dedicated MissingBackup column=1 for Yuma and is excluded from A_MoreIndoorThanB/DiffPersonHours (November Yuma row: MissingBackup=1, A_MoreIndoorThanB=0, DiffPersonHours=0); the docx's Section 4 explicitly documents the 'Pending test, indoor backup' treatment and its separation from observed exceedance switches, with no imputation of AQI=0. All three conditions of DA007 (待测室内备用, 单独标记, 不混入观测超标或两政策差异) are met.

criteria.name: DA008

Calendar totals: Maricopa 3420, Pima 420, Yuma 180 (all match the 60-person-hour per-session rule). The calendar is reproducible from inputs: all 1097 observed AQI values match the EPA daily file exactly; A/B action flags and DiffPersonHours are deterministically derivable from AQI using the documented thresholds (A indoor at ≥101; B full-indoor at ≥151; B reduced-outdoor at 101–150). Yuma's single missing date (2024-11-26) is correctly flagged with MissingBackup_Flag=1 and included as a calendar row (1098 data rows total). Totals are internally consistent: sum of Monthly rows equals CountySummary rows; weekday-only sums from the calendar match the Monthly/CountySummary figures.

criteria.name: DA009
criteria.description:
重点县月和A/B资源差异建议由真实汇总支持，可落实备用场地和活动方式。
Inspect output/outdoor_activity_model.xlsx, output/activity_policy_brief.docx, output/review_calendar.csv.
criteria.reasoning: All three deliverables jointly satisfy DA009. outdoor_activity_model.xlsx contains the Monthly sheet (month × county) with real A/B resource-difference aggregation: A_Indoor, B_FullIndoor, B_ReducedOutdoor, A_MoreIndoorThanB, DiffPersonHours — computed from verified EPA daily AQI data (DataAudit/AnnualReconciliation confirm the aggregation is grounded in the input files). The CountySummary rolls this up for the three key counties (Maricopa 04013, Pima 04019, Yuma 04027). activity_policy_brief.docx Section 3 explicitly quantifies the A-vs-B operational impact per county (Maricopa 57 days/3420 person-hours, Pima 7/420, Yuma 3/180) and Section 4 plus Section 7 lay out actionable backup venues ("indoor backup" for missing-data days) and activity methods (Policy A: full indoor at AQI≥101; Policy B: full indoor at ≥151, reduced-outdoor with indoor option at 101–150; discretionary upgrade on top). review_calendar.csv provides the day-level implementation calendar (1099 rows, 366×3 days) with A_Action/B_Action fields such as "Indoor (AQI>=101)", "Outdoor reduced + indoor option", "Outdoor", and flags A_Indoor_Flag / B_FullIndoor_Flag / B_ReducedOutdoor_Flag / MissingBackup_Flag — making the backup venues and activity methods directly actionable per date/county. The A/B difference claim is therefore supported by real aggregated EPA data and yields concrete, implementable backup-venue and activity-method guidance.

criteria.name: DA010
criteria.description:
不把回顾日AQI当实时预测、小时暴露或哮喘因果；明确监测覆盖、敏感人群和潜在非真实人时。
Inspect output/outdoor_activity_model.xlsx, output/activity_policy_brief.docx, output/review_calendar.csv.
criteria.reasoning: Criterion DA010 is fully satisfied across the three deliverables. The policy brief §7 explicitly disclaims: no real-time prediction ('does not claim operators knew AQI in advance'), no hourly exposure ('does not estimate hourly exposure'), no asthma/health causation ('does not infer asthma or other health outcomes'). Monitoring coverage is clarified in §4 and §7 (Yuma's missing 2024-11-26 handled by backup, no imputation). Sensitive populations are addressed in §7 (Policy B protects AQI>=151 indoors, offers indoor option at 101-150 USG range). The hypothetical/simulation nature is clearly framed: brief is titled 'Retrospective', §7 calls it a 'retrospective rule simulation', §3 models sessions as 40 people x 1.5h, and the Excel Sources sheet explicitly labels the decision constraints as 'Internal hypothetical business rules for this exercise; not public-source records'. The CSV preserves ObservationStatus and SitesReporting to surface monitoring coverage.

criteria.name: DA013
criteria.description:
ResourcePlan逐月满足900美元上限、每日最多一个县、不可分割且不结转，并达到可复算最高服务优先积分；提供足以核查最优性的依据，任意同样最优可行解均接受，不能只用无证明的贪心主张最优。
Inspect output/outdoor_activity_model.xlsx, output/activity_policy_brief.docx, output/review_calendar.csv.
criteria.reasoning: All three deliverables are internally consistent and satisfy the DA013 criterion. Independent DP verification (performed on the raw daily_aqi_by_county_2024.csv with the given constraints: $900/month budget, at-most-one-county-per-date, whole-session non-fungible funding, weekday costs + adjustments, weights 3/2/1, AQI 101-150 eligibility) yields identical optimal selections for all 12 months (47 sessions total, 2488 points, $6120 total cost). Budget never exceeds $900 per month (max is $880 in July and September). Dates are unique within each month, enforcing the one-county-per-date rule. Sessions are whole (no splitting), and unused monthly balance lapses (no carry-over). Optimality is evidenced, not merely asserted: the DecisionAudit sheet and the docx sections 5 and 6 explicitly describe the DP method, correctly reject the unreviewed greedy claim DA-D1 as a general rule (greedy coincidentally matches optimal in some months but isn't provably optimal), and correctly reject DA-D2 (baseline non-fungible). The CSV's 47 selected rows match the ResourcePlan's 47 selected rows exactly. The solution is verified to be one of the optimal feasible solutions.
